No Seeds

Privacy Policy

Effective October 14, 2026 · Beta

No Seeds Dating is in beta. This policy explains what we collect, why, who can see it, and how to delete it. No Seeds is only for adults 18 and older. We never sell your information.

What we collect

  • Account: your email address and first name. If you sign in with Google, Google shares your name, email address, profile picture link and account ID. We never receive your Google password, contacts, files or calendar.
  • Profile: date of birth, gender, who you want to meet, age range, city, ZIP code, relationship goals, bio, prompt answers, interests, and optional lifestyle answers such as faith.
  • Pledge answers: your confirmations about not having or wanting children, and the community commitments.
  • Photos: up to 6 profile photos. We re-save each photo before upload, which removes hidden details such as where it was taken.
  • Activity: likes, passes, matches, blocks, messages, typing status, and date plans.
  • Location: your city and ZIP code. If you choose to share your device location, we turn it into a city and ZIP code and do not keep the exact position.
  • Reports: safety reports you file and reports about you.
  • Technical data: sign-in times, browser and device type, and error logs kept by our service providers.

Sensitive information

Some answers can reveal sensitive information, such as who you want to date or your faith. We use them only to run No Seeds for you: reviewing profiles, showing compatible members, and suggesting dates. We do not sell them or use them for advertising. Optional answers can be removed at any time.

How we use it

  • Create your account and keep you signed in.
  • Review every profile before other members can see it.
  • Show you compatible members by gender, age range and travel distance.
  • Run matching, chat and the date planner. The planner finds a halfway point between two members' ZIP codes and suggests public places near it. Neither member sees the other's ZIP code or location.
  • Investigate reports, remove content that breaks our Terms, and keep members safe.

What other members see

Approved members see your first name, age, city, photos, bio, prompt answers, interests, relationship goals and lifestyle answers. They never see your email address, exact date of birth, ZIP code or pledge answers. Your matches see the messages you send them and date plans you share.

Who we share it with

We do not sell personal information or share it for advertising, and we do not run advertising trackers. We share it only with:

  • Service providers that run the app for us: Supabase (database, sign-in, sign-in emails, photo storage), Google (sign-in, ZIP code lookups and place suggestions; place searches send only general areas, never your name), and our website host.
  • Legal and safety needs: when the law requires it, or to protect members or the public.

How long we keep it

We keep your information while your account is open. When you delete your account, we delete your profile, photos, likes and matches within 30 days. Messages you sent may stay visible to the person you sent them to. We keep safety reports and records of removed accounts for up to 2 years to protect members.

Your choices

  • Edit your profile, remove photos and change optional answers at any time.
  • Ask for a copy of your information, a correction, or account deletion by emailing thegiftedbystarr@gmail.com. We reply within 30 days.
  • Depending on where you live, state law may give you more rights. We honor these requests for every member.

Security

Access rules make sure only the right people can see profiles, photos and messages. Photos are stored privately and shown through links that expire. No system is perfectly secure, so protect your email and Google account.

Adults only

No Seeds is not for anyone under 18. If we learn someone under 18 has an account, we delete it.

Changes and contact

If we make important changes, we will tell you in the app before they take effect. Questions: thegiftedbystarr@gmail.com.
